head.text: RTC read - DEVMAP multiplexes CPU A7-A0 and D31-D24 onto the DS12887 AD bus

signal.name: state
signal.data: S0 S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S0 S1 S2 S3

foot.text: The RTC runs in Motorola mode (MOT tied high). Its address strobe falls with nRTC_CS while U34 drives CPU A7-A0, so each RTC register is directly addressable at 0x30000300 + n. On the first falling clock edge RTC_A_SEL turns U34 off, raises DS and enables U35 towards D31-D24. With no wait states, DS is high for only about one clock (50 ns at 20 MHz). Check that against the DS12887 bus-timing table (not in datasheets/) if RTC accesses misbehave.
